reason: B is the better proposal because high-temperature dislocation climb, cross-slip, and recovery are more physically plausible and directly testable under sustained loading than A’s poorly supported extrapolation of cryogenic FCC nanotwinning evidence to a BCC refractory alloy at ~800°C. B remains imperfect—lattice distortion does not necessarily enhance recovery, and an HEA-versus-W comparison alone does not isolate lattice distortion—but it offers the more credible mechanistic test.
